result.title: FactorSpec: Serving Exact Relational Constraints as Speculative Drafts
result.summary: Speculative decoding speeds up LLM serving by drafting tokens that the target model verifies in one pass, and its gain grows with the drafts the target accepts. Structured outputs should be an ideal case, because much of a record follows from relations among its fields: an itinerary's days follow from its cities' stays and flights. Serving engines, however, draft such text by proposing it from the prompt or a learned head, and their grammar masks enforce only syntax, so the model must satisfy the relations, which it violates: on NATURAL PLAN's trip problems, Qwen3-8B writes a valid itinerary for 10%, and retries that name the violated relation raise this to 14%. We present FactorSpec, which serves exact relational constraints as speculative drafts. FactorSpec compiles a JSON Schema and its relations into a factor graph with an exact feasibility check, drafts every token the constraint determines as certain, verifies each request at a width chosen for it, and computes the masks in worker processes outside the scheduler while the GPU runs. In SGLang, its drafts yield up to 10.5 tokens per verify step, up to 1.9x those of the fastest n-gram drafter, and it decodes up to 1.43x faster than speculators tuned per load, at a grammar mask's cost; it also leads in vLLM. Because every record is also valid, it serves up to 13.9x the valid records per GPU-second of syntax-only baselines.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 FactorSpec：把 JSON Schema 及字段间关系编译成带精确可行性检验的因子图，将约束已决定的 token 作为确定性草稿送入推测解码，并为每个请求选择合适的验证宽度，从而在 SGLang/vLLM 中加速结构化输出生成并保证记录有效。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「约束推导出确定性草稿 + 按请求自适应验证宽度 + 精确可行性检验」的猜测—检验结构，可能与 LVR 中动态计算分配、验证与停止决策的问题表述有概念联系，但该工作面向文本结构化输出的服务加速，无视觉或多模态状态，迁移价值需核查。
